items.title: Jerry Dodgion interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Sweets was on the band too, Harry Edison was on the band. That was the first time, well not the first time I’ve played in a recording with him

ctx.x: And he did great. He was added for that date and Sweets was on the band too, Harry Edison was on the band. That was the first time, well not the first time I’ve played in a recording with him, but he soloed and everything. It was great. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
Yeah, the arrangements did a good job of — the theme was Broadway tunes or whatever and to fit them in the Basie style.
